_rule: Clip-level test labels, checked by eye on frames every 2-8 s (21.11.2026). positive: seconds in which an ambulance (white, red strips) is visible; ignore: seconds where it is unclear, not scored; a video with no positive interval was checked to have no ambulance in the sampled frames. Excluded: videos filmed from inside or onto the ambulance (dashcam, selfie, the ambulance is the camera) and videos where it cannot be told whether an ambulance is visible. Sparse sampling: a short ambulance appearance between sampled frames in a long compilation can be missed; any alarm in an ambulance-free video is checked by eye before it is counted as false.
